parsed.reason: Both identify the non-atomic check-then-act in login(): current() and _issue() each take the lock separately, so a concurrent operation can slip between them. Description A centers on concurrent sign-ins minting duplicate tokens (with the revoke-resurrection as a secondary note), while Description B centers on a concurrent revoke being undone and the revoked token being re-registered. The shared root cause and location match, and A explicitly names the logout/revoke resurrection case, so they describe the same defect.
